# @ndigo/view-toon

TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) view technology for Ndigo — text/toon output, a negotiation resolver, and a prompt encoder.

Version-matched export index for the installed package. Read `README.md`
for usage; the workspace guide index ships with `@ndigo/cli` as
`assets/agent/docs-index.md`.

## Subpaths

- `@ndigo/view-toon/encode`

## Public exports

- `TOONView`
- `toonViewResolver` — Builds a resolver that serves TOONView for one logical view name.
- `TOONEncodeOptions` *(type)* — TOON encoding options, mirroring the reference encoder's supported surface (spec §9): indentation width for nested lines, and the row/inline-array delimiter —…
- `encodeToon` — Encodes a JSON-model value as a TOON document (spec v4.4).
